issue.title: [Bug]: Built-in grep mishandles encoding in some files mixing Chinese and Western text
issue.body:
### Version line

v2 — Go rewrite (1.x), main-v2 (active development)

### Exact version

1.23.0

### What happened?

grep 搜索部分中西文混合文件时无法正确处理编码问题。以下是Reasonix自己的报告：

> 诊断完成，证据链完整。以下是内置 grep 的完整情况说明。
> 
> 结论
> 内置 grep 工具（Go 重写版，docs/MIGRATING.md 说明它「匹配前会解码文件」）对无 BOM 的纯中文 UTF-8 文件做了错误的编码检测：把 UTF-8 字节按 GBK/GB18030 解码。结果：
> 
> 中文 pattern → 匹配不到（pattern 是 UTF-8，与 GBK 解码后的乱码文本比对自然失败）；
> ASCII pattern（如 1931、thesis-citation）→ 能匹配，但输出行中文全部乱码；
> 文件本身没有任何问题——read_file、外部命令行 rg 都正常。
> 证据链
> 乱码确认：内置 grep 搜 `待排印正文/02-02-第2章第2节.md` 的 1931，输出 `## 绗�簩鑺傘€€鈥滅粺涓€鎴樼嚎鈥...`。我用 PowerShell 模拟「取原文 UTF-8 字节 → 按 GBK 解码」，得到完全一致的乱码：`## 绗簩鑺傘€€鈥滅粺涓€鎴樼嚎鈥...`。反向还原也成立。
> 与 ASCII 占比强相关（全仓统计）：
> 误判失败：待排印正文 全部正文文件，ASCII 占比 0.8%–15.4%（中文为主）。
> 正常：`论文.md`（19.8%，且开头是 YAML front matter）、`研究工作/.../1994俄文档案集...md`（18.7%）、`项目治理/状态/当前占用.md`（45.9%）、`00-03-英文摘要占位稿.md`（100%）。
> 带 BOM 的 UTF-8 文件正常：`冷审计/档案/材料索引/文件索引_中文.csv`（UTF-8-sig）搜「统一战线」完美命中——说明 BOM 能帮助检测器正确识别编码。
> 阈值大致在 ASCII 占比 16% 上下（15.4% 的 03-02 未逐一验证，但 18.7% 以上正常）。

### Steps to reproduce

见上

### OS / platform

win10 19045.7548

### Relevant logs or output

```shell

```

fixed_in: studio <= v2.20.0 (encoding.TrimPartialRune character-safe peek); 1.x PRs #8321/#8322 never merged
steps:
Create a Chinese Markdown file (UTF-8, no BOM) by running exactly this shell command:

```bash
python3 -c "open('chapter2.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write('统一战线的历史与理论研究。\n'*300+'## 1931年九一八事变\n')" && wc -c chapter2.md && tail -1 chapter2.md
```
Use your built-in grep tool to search chapter2.md for 统一战线, and then search it for 1931. Show me exactly what each search returned.
expected: grep decodes the UTF-8 file as UTF-8: the Chinese pattern matches and the 1931 line prints as '## 1931年九一八事变' (read_file and rg handle the same file correctly per the issue).
defect: The native grep scanner detects the encoding from an 8 KiB peek that ends mid-rune, so utf8.Valid fails and the file is decoded as GB18030: Chinese patterns miss and matched lines come back as mojibake.

fault location.explanation: Contributing source location. See Root cause and the evidence review for observed behavior and limitations.
Contributing source location. See Root cause and the evidence review for observed behavior and limitations.

Root cause: Native grep detects encoding from an 8192-byte prefix without trimming an incomplete trailing UTF-8 character. Strict UTF-8 validation then fails and can select GB18030, causing Chinese searches to miss and returned text to become mojibake. The retained native-grep results show these symptoms. This does not establish the issue reporter's alternative ASCII-ratio hypothesis.
